judge-1-write: The student writes steadily with the pencil, the pencil tip moving across the red card; he pauses and glances at the page; light gently shifts; slow push-in.
judge-2-seal: The hand slides the paper down into the red envelope and the flap folds closed over the green check; the other hand steadies the envelope; sunburst rays glow; gentle push-in.
judge-4-scale: The balance scale sways gently, the two pans tipping up and down before settling perfectly level; the rays behind glow softly; slow push-in.
recall-1-night: The young woman in the red sweater writes in her notebook, then pauses and taps the pencil on the page; the lamp glow flickers faintly, the waveform on the monitor pulses; the night sky outside is still; slow push-in from behind.
recall-2-calendar: Calendar pages tear off one after another and flutter away across the frame on the wind, drifting toward the sunset; gentle camera drift sideways.
recall-3-question: The young woman in the red sweater frowns at the page, chin on hand, then slowly lifts her pencil, unsure; the sound-wave lines on the paper ripple faintly; subtle push-in on her face.
recall-4-thread: A glowing green thread of light flows out of the old notebook on the shelf and travels across the room to her open notebook, sparks drifting along it; she keeps writing and her page lights up; slow push-in.
live-1-talk: The young woman in the red sweater talks animatedly, hands moving as she explains; the red and green sound waves pulse outward from her toward the laptop in rhythm with her speech; the cat's ear twitches; gentle push-in.
live-2-waves: The black sound wave on the left pulses as if speaking, then falls quiet while the green wave inside the computer screen answers in rhythm, then the right wave echoes it; the screen glows; slow push-in.
live-3-meter: The gauge needle sweeps steadily upward toward the red zone, then stops just short of it and falls back to rest; the rays behind glow; locked-off camera.
first-1-door: The student walks through the open red door into the bright room, the door swinging gently; sunlight spreads across the floor; the camera follows slowly forward.
first-2-dials: A hand turns a big knob and slides a fader upward; the meter needles swing and small red lamps blink along the panel; slow push-in.
first-3-teachers: The three teachers come to life: the one on the desk gestures wide, the coach bounces the ball once, the librarian turns a page on her clipboard and looks up; gentle push-in.
first-4-desk: The young woman in the red sweater settles at the desk and opens the notebook; steam rises from the mug, leaves sway outside and the sunrise brightens slowly; slow push-in from behind.
